annotations.text:
HOME — the empty space is filled with things the game already tracks, not decoration.

• Progress and Continue are now one card, so the button says where it is taking you.
• Booster counts (3 / 2 / 4) — real save data, and a reason to open the app.
• Nearest achievement — 'Reef Runner 38 / 50'. Your twenty achievements have no presence anywhere in the game today; this gives them one and puts a next goal on the first screen.

All three read state the game keeps already. Nothing here needs new tracking. The mascot came down to 128px to make room without crowding.

REEF POP — the chosen direction, now across all eight screens.

Sunlit shallows, sticker blocks with white keylines, hard drop shadows, Fredoka + Nunito.

Kept: the octopus, the 8×8 board, the 3-slot tray, and your seven block colours, which the spec fixes so the board stays readable.

Replaced: palette, typography and the chunky button lip — depth now comes from white keylines and a hard offset shadow.

TWO PROPOSALS, NOT TRANSLATIONS — easy to drop if you disagree.

The lose sheet offers a rewarded 'watch an ad for 5 more moves' continue. It is the biggest revenue lever in this genre and it is opt-in, but it does not exist in the game yet.

The map is a descending dive log, so the twenty chapters from Tide Pools to Still Water read as a descent rather than a list.

Not chosen, kept for reference. A — Deep Current: abyssal dark, blocks glowing like bioluminescence. B — Paper Tide: riso print, warm paper, ink outlines. Bottom row is the first Reef Pop draft, before the home screen's empty space was filled — useful as a before/after.
